description: This file provides environment configuration utilities that safely access environment variables in a browser-compatible manner, supporting different build toolchains like Vite and Create React App (CRA). It includes functions for normalizing string values, validating URLs, and retrieving environment variables without direct references to potentially undefined globals, ensuring compatibility across environments.

methods.name: normalizeString(value)
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string or undefined if null, undefined, or empty.

methods.name: isValidUrl(value)
methods.description: Checks whether a given string is a valid HTTP/HTTPS URL.

methods.name: getImportMetaEnvSafe()
methods.description: Safely retrieves import.meta.env in a way that doesn't break in non-Vite environments.

methods.name: getProcessEnvSafe()
methods.description: Safely retrieves process.env if it exists, considering that process may be undefined in browser environments.

methods.name: getEnv()
methods.description: Returns an object with configuration environment variables, normalized and compatible across different build tools.

calls: Function("try { return (typeof import !== 'undefined' && import.meta && import.meta.env) ? import.meta.env : undefined; } catch (e) { return undefined; }")()
